title: Legionella
description: Legionella Pneumophila bacterium monitoring and risk assessment tool. Assess water system temperatures and determine the risk of Legionella development.

components.content:
# Legionella Risk Assessment

The Legionella Pneumophila bacterium thrives in water supply systems and air conditioning systems - and may cause Legionnaires disease.

## Critical Temperature Ranges

- **Danger Zone:** 69°F (20.5°C) to 122°F (50°C) - Bacteria thrives
- **Survival Limit:** Up to 131°F (55°C) for 5-6 hours
- **Destruction:** Above 158°F (70°C) - Instantaneous destruction
- **Safe Operating:** At least 140°F (60°C) - General protection

## High-Risk Systems

- Cooling towers and evaporative condensers
- Scrubber systems with low temperatures
- Low temperature hot water supply systems

## Prevention Measures

- Keep basins and sumps free of mud and organic debris
- Use chemical and organic inhibitors where recommended
- Avoid water stagnation - circulate the water through the system
- Avoid leaks from processes to the cooling water
- Maintain proper operating temperatures

**Warning:** Tap water at 140°F can cause full-thickness burn in 10 seconds. Always mix down to lower temperature before the tap.
